edges.reason: BotProtected constructor writes the _botProtection argument into the botProtection state variable.
Constructor parameter _botProtection is consumed by the BotProtected constructor.
The checkBots modifier executes the low-level external call to botProtection.
botProtection is an arbitrary external contract whose call can reenter the token before the guarded function body runs.
Modifier parameter _from is encoded into the bot protection calldata.
Modifier parameter _to is encoded into the bot protection calldata.
Modifier parameter _value is encoded into the bot protection calldata.
The checkBots modifier reads uniPair when building the external call arguments.
Constructor parameter _botProtection is forwarded to the base BotProtected constructor.
msg.sender becomes the owner, granting unrestricted access to list() and delegate().
Constructor grants msg.sender an infinite allowance over the derived uniPair.
Constructor stores the pairFor result into the uniPair state variable.
Constructor invokes the pairFor helper to derive the pair address.
Constructor writes the allowance mapping for the contract and for msg.sender.
Constructor references the uniRouter state variable when granting allowance.
delegate() checks msg.sender against the owner state variable before executing.
list() checks msg.sender against the owner state variable before minting balances.
transfer() parameter _to is used in the delegated transferFrom call.
transfer() parameter _value is used in the delegated transferFrom call.
transfer() delegates all logic to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value).
transferFrom parameter _from indexes the balance and allowance mappings.
transferFrom parameter _to is credited in the balance mapping.
transferFrom parameter _value drives all balance and allowance mutations.
transferFrom applies the checkBots modifier, which performs an external call before any balance update.
msg.sender is the spender whose allowance is checked and decremented in transferFrom.
transferFrom performs an unchecked subtraction on the allowance mapping.
transferFrom performs an unchecked subtraction on the sender balance.
transferFrom performs an unchecked addition on the recipient balance.
transferFrom mutates the public balanceOf mapping.
transferFrom mutates the public allowance mapping.
approve parameter _spender indexes the allowance mapping.
approve parameter _value is written into the allowance mapping.
approve writes allowance under msg.sender as the owner key.
approve assigns an arbitrary allowance value with no race protection.
delegate() parameter a is the delegatecall target address.
delegate() parameter b is the raw calldata forwarded to delegatecall.
delegate() requires msg.sender to equal the owner before executing arbitrary code.
delegate() executes the unsafe delegatecall operation.
The delegatecall runs attacker-supplied code in the token's context, allowing arbitrary storage writes and reentry.
pairFor parameter tokenA is used to sort the token addresses.
pairFor parameter tokenB is used to sort the token addresses.
pairFor assigns the lower token address to the token0 local.
pairFor assigns the higher token address to the token1 local.
The CREATE2-derived pair address returned by pairFor is stored in uniPair.
list() parameter _numList becomes the contract balance and the liquidity amount.
list() parameter _tos is iterated to airdrop balances.
list() parameter _amounts provides the airdropped balances.
list() requires msg.sender to equal owner, and msg.sender also receives 6% of the total supply.
list() computes totalSupply * 6 / 100 with unchecked raw arithmetic.
list() overwrites entries of the balanceOf mapping for the contract and recipients.
list() reads the totalSupply state variable to size the owner allocation.
list() derives the router deadline from block.timestamp, a miner-influenceable value.
list() performs an external addLiquidityETH call to the router before the airdrop loop, enabling reentrancy.
list() invokes the external call through the uniRouter state variable.
The loop index i drives iteration over _tos and _amounts in list().
SafeMath.sub(a,b) delegates to the overload carrying an error message.
SafeMath.div(a,b) delegates to the overload carrying an error message.
